newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Ta Fu debuts at HK$1.40 per share.
newsitem.headline: HK's Ta Fu debuts at HK$1.40 per share.

text.p: Shares of Taiwan-based timber products processor Ta Fu International Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$1.40 per share on Friday, compared with an issue price of HK$1.01 per share.
Ta Fu shares eased to HK$1.25 after hitting a high of HK$1.45 shortly after the start of trading.

Ta Fu offered 168 million new shares and raised nearly HK$170 million before expenses to finance outstanding equity contributions to seven existing joint venture companies and achieve further integration of its timber operations.
Ta Fu has 19 joint ventures in China, an associate company in Taiwan and a subsidiary in Brazil.
